source: Only the six derived Google Sheets report tabs, refreshed by rebuildReportingData().

FactDepartmentPerformance.grain: one row per department per refresh

FactDelivery.grain: one row per delivery metric snapshot

FactDailyProduction.grain: one row per date and department

DimDate.source: DAX calendar generated from imported report-date columns

relationships: DimDepartment[Department ID] 1:* FactProduction[Current Department ID] (single direction)
DimDate[Date] 1:* FactProduction[Order Date] active; Completion Date and Required Delivery Date inactive
DimDate[Date] 1:* FactTasks[Completed Date] inactive; Deadline inactive
modelRules: Import only the six Report* tabs; do not import transactional or backup tabs.
Use one-way dimension-to-fact filtering; never relate facts directly.
Set all IDs and statuses to Text, quantities/counts to Whole Number, percentages/durations to Decimal Number, and report dates to Date or Date/Time.
Do not sum FactTasks or department-stage quantities to calculate final production quantity.
